text:
sre_bot: Pager -> high p99 latency on /v1/chat/completions in eu-west1. model=mistral-7b, p99 ~2.8s over 5m, 48 alerts. Paging: @alex @maya

alex: ack, joining. I'm seeing increased request queue lengths on gcpu-serve-3.

maya: also seeing a KV cache miss spike + lots of small requests (token-length < 40). possible cold-cache churn.

jordan: is this limited to mistral-7b or spreading to other model groups?

maya: mostly mistral-7b and a small uptick on 7b-quant variants. gpt-style routes look fine atm.

alex: immediate mitigation plan: Canary a fallback to the lighter model group for /v1/chat/completions in eu-west1. Will gate with canary nodes.

ops_bot: Deploy started: canary-fallback-v2 -> 3 nodes (eu-west1). CI: https://ci.internal/runs/4523

maya: also proposing a temporary alert squelch for that specific route/model so oncall doesn't get flooded while we validate.

priya: +1 to squelch, but keep a shorter-lived, non-paging alert to ops channel. Add an ephemeral dashboard panel for requests > 1s. If sustained for >15m, escalate.

alex: agreed. I'll edit the alert rule: set p99 threshold to 3.0s for mistral-7b /v1/chat/completions in eu-west1 and add a 10m debounce. Posting the edit I'm making below for visibility: 

```
avg_over_time(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat/completions",region="eu-west1",model=~"mistral-.*"}[5m])) by (le))[10m:1m]) > 3
```

maya: nice. pls include `route` and `model` labels so we can be selective per-path.

jordan: long term, can we make alerts baseline-relative? i.e., trigger only if p99 > baseline * 1.5 for a sustained window. reduces noise when baselines drift.

alex: we don't have dynamic baseline alerting in prod rules yet. Action: add RFC for dynamic hysteresis + per-model baselines.

priya: I'll file INF-4721 to track: "p99 sensitivity rebalance — per-model/per-route thresholds + dynamic hysteresis + dashboard panels"

ops_bot: JIRA created: https://jira.internal/browse/INF-4721

maya: quick checklist from thread: 1) temp squelch/change p99 -> 3.0s for mistral-7b eu-west1 (alex) 2) ephemeral dashboard panel for >1s requests (maya) 3) RFC for dynamic hysteresis (jordan) 4) post-incident customer impact triage (priya)

priya: customer-impact check: Support flagged 2 customers with degraded responses (timeouts/long tail >30s) via ticket ST-998. Escalating to SEs.

alex: reaching out to SEs. We can enable per-tenant fallback to small-model for those two org_ids as short-term mitigation.

maya: yes, we can add tenant override routing rule for those org ids and validate on canary.

jordan: keep the alerting to ops channel (non-pager) while canary runs, pages only if sustained beyond the 15m window.

alex: canary rolled out. p99 on canary nodes trending down to ~1.9s. monitoring closely. :thumbsup:

maya: once canary stabilizes, revert global squelch and replace alert with per-model thresholds + the new dashboard panel. I'll attach screenshots to INF-4721.

sre_bot: Incident note: mitigation applied and validated on canary; reduced latency. Please file a short post-incident summary in INF-4721 within 48h. :memo:

alex: filing debrief now. Short notes: root cause suspected KV cache churn + request mix shift; mitigations: canary model fallback + per-tenant overrides; follow-ups: INF-4721 RFC, dashboard, adjust long-term alerting to baseline-relative (owner: jordan).

maya: quick follow — when we implement per-route thresholds, include p95 hysteresis too (p95 tends to capture small-but-wide regressions).

priya: noted. adding p95 action to INF-4721.

jordan: thanks team. closing the pager. will monitor for 2h and then mark incident as mitigated.

ops_bot: Pager closed by alex. Metrics continue to trend downward.
